They have mice n rats which is hard to find in nyc. Cheaper than petco. If your snakes only eat live check them out
Great little pet shop. From tropical fish, bearded dragons, and cornsnakes, to some really rare and exotic snakes and lizards.
Iit was okay but I found it difficult to find nearby parking.

I've been visiting this place since it first opened. I've lived in the area for a long time, and I can say that their service is excellent. The staff is very kind to people and, more importantly, to animals. I trust their vets, and the prices are good compared to other places. I highly recommend this place and the veterinarian, Mayo, who is a sweetheart. She's helped me many times with my girls. What matters most to me is their love for animals, and that's why I'll always be a loyal and happy customer. Please visit this place; you won't regret it.

They don’t have any kind of variety with dog toys. All of their accessories are stupid expensive. It doesn’t make any sense. My dog likes it there though, but I’m debating whether I should even consider going back or I should just order from Amazon. At least I have a higher chance of saving money and getting my money’s worth at the same time Sorry

Small shop but EXCELLENT customer service!!! They always treat my dog like a king when I get his hair cut, and if they dont have something they will call their other store to help find what I need. You can't beat good customer service and helpfulness like this these days!
